ng-add.description: Install ShipAngular into an Angular project — adds dependencies, scaffolds env.ts, optionally enables SSR.

module.description: Scaffold an app-owned feature under src/app/modules/<name>/ with manifest, routes, index, and MODULE.md.

page.description: Scaffold a standalone, OnPush, signal-first page under src/app/modules/<module>/pages/<name>/.

auth-adapter.description: Scaffold a custom AuthAdapter implementation pre-wired to pass the conformance suite.

api-client.description: Scaffold a typed, browser/SSR-safe operation-client provider for a packed ShipAPI contract.

operation-resource.description: Scaffold a signal-tracked read resource for a stable operation ID.

operation-mutation.description: Scaffold a typed mutation state machine for a stable operation ID.

operation-auth.description: Scaffold an operation-backed cookie-session auth boundary with explicit identity decoding.

stream.description: Scaffold a typed service over a generated ShipAPI operation stream binding.

download.description: Scaffold a typed service over a generated ShipAPI operation download binding.

socket.description: Scaffold an injectable factory over a generated ShipAPI operation socket binding.

upload.description: Scaffold a progress-aware component over a generated ShipAPI operation upload binding.

signed-upload.description: Scaffold an injectable factory over a generated signed-upload binding.

operation-form.description: Scaffold a typed form factory over a generated client-safe operation binding.

operation-query.description: Generate a typed safe query with explicit application bindings.
